headline: Alphabet Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Alphabet reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenues up 25% to $127.6 billion, with Google Cloud revenues up 103% to $30.7 billion and operating margin of 31.8%. Net income available to common stockholders was $26.2 billion, or $2.12 diluted EPS for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Alphabet Announces Dividend on Series A and Series B Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock
summary: Alphabet's Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $15.63 per share on each Series A and Series B mandatory convertible preferred stock (about $0.78 per Depositary Share), payable November 15, 2026 to holders of record as of November 1, 2026.

headline: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
summary: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago. For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 74.8% and 74.9%, respectively. GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.70 and $2.68, respectively. “Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.”

headline: The platform approach to becoming Frontier
summary: Judson Althoff, CEO of Microsoft's commercial business, outlines a platform approach to Frontier Transformation built on Copilot, the Microsoft IQ platform and Agent 365, and highlights customer examples including Volkswagen, Fujitsu, KPMG and Truist. The post ties these stories to Microsoft's latest earnings and invites readers to Microsoft Ignite in November.

headline: Microsoft Announces First Quarter Results
summary: Microsoft reported first quarter fiscal year 2027 results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with revenue of $92.3 billion (up 19%) and GAAP net income of $36.6 billion (up 32%). Non-GAAP net income was $36.4 billion (up 18%), excluding the impact of OpenAI investments, and Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $63.9 billion (up 30%).

headline: Meta Announces Pricing of Offering of Depositary Shares Representing Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock and Offering of Class A Common Stock in Connection with Forward Sale Agreements
summary: Meta announced the pricing of two concurrent underwritten offerings: 250,000,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/20th interest in a 6.50% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock at $50 per depositary share, and $25.0 billion of Class A common stock at $625.00 per share, the latter tied to forward sale agreements with Morgan Stanley Capital Services LLC and Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC. The Depositary Shares Offering is expected to yield about $12.5 billion in net proceeds, and the Common Stock Offering is expected to yield about $24.9 billion upon forward settlement by November 19, 2027.

headline: Apple TV becomes the new U.S. home of F1 ACADEMY™, the all‑female racing series
summary: Apple and F1 ACADEMY announced that the all-female racing series will stream exclusively on Apple TV in the United States beginning in 2027, with every qualifying session and race available to subscribers. The deal expands Apple TV's Formula 1 coverage, which began with a five-year U.S. broadcast partnership starting in 2026.

headline: Meta Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: Meta Platforms, Inc.'s board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.525 per share on its Class A and Class B common stock. The dividend is payable on September 28, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on September 21, 2026.

headline: Microsoft announces quarterly dividend increase
summary: Microsoft's board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.98 per share, a 7 cent (8%) increase over the previous quarter, payable Dec. 10, 2026 to shareholders of record on Nov. 19, 2026. The company also announced its 2026 Annual Shareholders Meeting will be held virtually on Dec. 8, 2026, with a Sept. 30, 2026 record date for voting.

headline: NVIDIA Board of Directors Establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
summary: News Summary NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that the Board of Directors has established the National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee, a new standing committee responsible for board-level oversight of the company’s national security policies, export control compliance and global trade risk management. NVIDIA’s existing National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team will report directly to the Committee and to Interim CEO, Colette Kress, on day-to-day operations.
